svg.title: About me: I'm a back-end developer based in Salvador, Brazil, and since June 2026 a developer at QCA — Queiroz Cavalcanti Advocacia. I started in 2021 with front-end, moved through React, and today I work mainly with Node.js/Express and C#/.NET on relational databases. I enjoy systems with real business rules — payroll calculation, access control, auditing — and keeping them covered by tests. Web Development graduate, studying Information Systems at UNIFACS.
